item.title: ElasticSearch Monitoring Guide
item.description: The text covers key ElasticSearch monitoring metrics, including search performance, indexing, memory usage, and garbage collection. It provides dashboard configuration examples for clusters and indices. The text also addresses common issues like poor query and indexing performance, describing root causes, troubleshooting, and solutions. It discusses building a reliable monitoring system using Prometheus.
